-- Spammer Core Logic
local function sendChatMessage(msg)
    pcall(function()
        if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
            local generalChannel = TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
            if generalChannel then
                generalChannel:SendAsync(msg)
                return
            end
        end
    end)

    pcall(function()
        local chatRemote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents")
        if chatRemote and chatRemote:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest") then
            chatRemote.SayMessageRequest:FireServer(msg, "All")
        end
    end)
end

local function generateMessage()
    local keys = {"Cars", "Objects", "Nature", "HumanMade"}
    local randomKey = keys[math.random(1, #keys)]
    local subList = categories[randomKey]
    local randomItem = subList[math.random(1, #subList)]
    
    local target = TargetBox.Text
    local hiddenChar = "\204\128"
    local finalMsg = ""
    
    if target ~= "" and target ~= " " then
        finalMsg = "@" .. target .. " " .. customPrefix .. " TMKX MEH " .. randomItem .. hiddenChar
    else
        finalMsg = customPrefix .. " TMKX MEH " .. randomItem .. hiddenChar
    end
    
    return finalMsg
end

local spamming = false

ToggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    spamming = not spamming
    if spamming then
        ToggleButton.Text = "STOP SPAM"
        ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
        
        local userDelay = tonumber(DelayBox.Text)
        if not userDelay or userDelay < 0.3 then 
            userDelay = 1.2
        end
        
        task.spawn(function()
            while spamming do
                pcall(function()
                    local msg = generateMessage()
                    sendChatMessage(msg)
                end)
                task.wait(userDelay)
            end
        end)
    else
        ToggleButton.Text = "START SPAM ($spam)"
        ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 90)
    end
end)

LocalPlayer.Chatted:Connect(function(message)

end)
